news.title: I can’t help rooting for tiny open source AI model maker Arcee
news.description: Arcee is a tiny 26-person U.S. startup that built a high-performing, massive, open source LLM. And it's gaining popularity with OpenClaw users.

news.title: Firmus, the ‘Southgate’ AI data center builder backed by Nvidia, hits $5.5B valuation
news.description: Nvidia-backed Asia AI data center provider Firmus has now raised $1.35 billion in six months.

news.title: Anthropic debuts preview of powerful new AI model Mythos in new cybersecurity initiative
news.description: The new model will be used by a small number of high-profile companies to engage in defensive cybersecurity work.

news.title: Uber is the latest to be won over by Amazon’s AI chips
news.description: Uber is expanding its AWS contract to run more of its ride-sharing features on Amazon's chips. This is a thumb-of-the nose at Oracle and Google.

news.title: OpenAI encourages firms to trial four-day weeks to adapt to AI era
news.description: The ChatGPT-maker said its early policy ideas aim to prompt discussions about action needed as AI systems become more capable.

news.title: Businesses scramble to get noticed by AI search
news.description: Firms are changing the way they present information on their websites, so they get noticed by AI.

news.title: China is winning one AI race, the US another - but either might pull ahead
news.description: Both sides don't want to let their rival dominate. And the competition may yet be transformed further.

news.title: How China fell for a lobster: What an AI assistant tells us about Beijing's ambition
news.description: The AI agent sparked a frenzy of "raising lobsters" in March, with users training the tool to suit their needs.
